subtitle: No target column. Which rows naturally belong together?

caption: Known groups let us check how each method behaves -- real data is never this tidy.

code:
Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(df)
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10).fit(Xs)
print(pd.Series(km.labels_).value_counts())   # 100, 100, 100
print(silhouette_score(Xs, km.labels_))       # 0.773
caption: Distance-based, just like k-NN -- a big-scale feature would dominate otherwise.
